notes: Concord Long-Burn Drive Mk3, a hull mount (outward is up): a longer bell with a flared nozzle extension at the mouth, blue rings and cooling tubes, four fuel drums (two each side) with cabling between them; inside the Mk2 dial plus the coolant pump and a cable harness. Damaged: the skirt lip dented and hanging, the bell cracked and sputtering, a cooling tube kinked, the right drum weeping pale fuel, the dial glass cracked, lamps red, sparks. Disabled: the bell bent over at the neck, a drum split and slid off, a cooling tube snapped, the dial dead, the repair hatch popped. THIS FILE: the INSIDE half (core, power coupling, repair hatch; its top 4px overhang the inner wall face as a flange).
